name: Walkman
description: A music disc can be [term:insert][dark-gray]inserted[/dark-gray][/term] into these leggings to play it, or shift inserted to play it on loop. While they are playing music, you walk (not sprint) [effect:percent][dark-gray]10-20% faster[/dark-gray][/effect].

effects.explanation:
Level I: 10% faster
Level II: 20% faster
